selection.rule: Same strict Parkes metadata selection as N7; exclude all N7 four fresh days, N6 eight groups, N1/N2, historical/R40H/R37/R40CDE; up to four new days, minimum two. No fit or threshold selection on fresh spectra, labels or outcomes.

development: Authenticate N6 and N7 exact manifests, locks and receipts; reacquire 12 old groups (192 unique tile hashes) using original N6 or N7 seed. Confirm exact raw hashes, labels, parent path/decision, R40N7 temporal and rival features; reproduce frozen N7 tree-preserve and logistic-q01 decision masks on all four previously fresh groups. Audit exactly the two removed control alerts (WISE0350-5658 and GJ1005) and single lost positive WISE0350-5658: original parent/true path, active rows (audit only), actual ON/OFF contrasts, frequency trajectory, old/new features, fold winners and heldout scores. N7 four and N6 two old holdout groups audit only, same six N6 fit groups for all learning; no optimization on individual failures.
features: Run N7 witness unchanged. New continuity features from valid row masks at fixed contrast .5/1/2: longest positive run, longest gap, transitions, isolated support, count, support fraction; masked rows terminate runs. Parent residual local maximum within ±2 native bins, mean absolute offset, stability and amplitude; ON/OFF independent. Four directed 8-row folds: first-to-second, second-to-first, even-to-odd, odd-to-even. For each ON/OFF independently, choose best alternative template from all legal full 16-row R35B paths using ONLY the selected 8 training rows, require >2-bin distinction from parent on >=3 training rows; evaluate that fixed path in heldout 8 rows, contrast parent vs rival and train-test spread; compare winners' heldout agreement. Candidate parent path was preselected on all 16 rows, so fold witness is not independent detection, only disjoint rival selection/evaluation. Require >=4 valid candidate rows per fold plus prior >=12/16 or fail-open. Direct recalculation of both scores. No truth/gap injection labels in features.
decision: Frozen N7 rivals tree preserve and rivals logistic q01 as exact comparators, with unfiltered Joint Min rescue; compare new base+runs, base+folds, base+runs+folds, with logistic/ExtraTrees and three fixed thresholds preserve/q01/q05. Also matched retrained base. 24 new joint-veto variants plus fixed comparators; report all. Original parent path and Joint Min rescue unchanged, no rerouting; freeze fit and cutoffs before fresh test power reads. Zero paired losses ordinary/shared/weak, <=35/640 control rate and <=7/8 Learned05, compare previous rival gains. No external validation or promotion.
